newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin creates new company.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin creates new company.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said Thursday it formed a new company with Lehman Brothers Capital Partners III LP and a management team led by former Lockheed Martin executives.
It said they had completed a $525-million transaction establishing L-3 Communications as an independent company specializing in electronic component manufacturing.
L-3 Communications is composed of ten former Lockheed Martin companies, it added.
Lockheed Martin said it owned a 35-percent equity stake in the new company, while Lehman Brothers had 50 percent and the management team 15 percent.
Based in Bethesda, Maryland, Lockheed Martin provides aerospace, defense, and other high-technology products and services.
